Name: Siberian Husky Pet
Author: j0ules
Description:
Hello! This is a simple .xnb file that will make your dog a husky!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zmzmqKv.png[/img]﻿

Also, if you'd like to color one in yourself, I've made a template you can color in however you want!
[b]If you intend to use this template or modify my husky and distribute your edit, please credit me with a link! Thank you!

[/b]Absolutely do not redistribute my work or any work you create with the template for monetary gain!

If you're not sure how to install .xnb files, [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Index]check out this guide[/url].
Likewise, if you're not sure how to pack .xnb files to make use of the template, there are guides on the web!

Lastly, if you like my work or use my template, please consider [url=https://ko-fi.com/joules]buying me a coffee! ☕❤️[/url]
